Title: Log Analytics Windows Agent for Winter 2021 now generally available

Body.Content:
The Log Analytics Windows Agent for Winter 2021 is now available. This release contains a new troubleshooting tool and changes to how the agent handles certificate changes in Azure Services. As always, we suggest using the latest agent available.

If you have installed the Log Analytics Agent for Windows by using Azure extensions and have automatic extension updates turned on, this update will be applied automatically. The latest release is also available to download from the Advanced Settings section in Log Analytics in the Azure portal.

This release is the last officially supported release of the 32 bit agent.

More information

Review agent release notes. If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you require technical support and have a support plan, please submit a support ticket in Microsoft Azure Support or work with your Microsoft Technical Account Manager. If you would like to purchase a support plan, please explore the Azure support plans.
